assembly_audit.boundary: Actual coaxial passages, continuous wall/seat witnesses, head seating, access with upper cap removed, integral roots, fixed-spindle retention, keyed rotor fit/torque witnesses, sampled rigid vertical insertions and separate radial insertion of the dedicated leaf. Threads are major-diameter envelopes. Printed fits, key backlash, insertion under friction/compliance, screw standard selection, preload, stripping, stiffness and strength need physical qualification.

V7_additions.assembly_order: Body, lower rotor, bead keeper, lid, keyed upper rotor, cover/click leaf, internal upper carrier with pawls, removable reset bridge (radial at +1 mm then lower), bridge screw, outer upper shell and its two screws, central washer/retainer.

missing_V7_terms: Pickup pawl bias, snap-leaf compression and stored energy
Continuous-pull reset coordination and reverse coast load
force_budget.boundary: Starting dimensions and force-order checks only. Spring legs/anchors, real grades, friction, printed leaf behavior, wear and dynamic return require design review and physical measurement. No strength, fatigue, acoustic, retention or reliable-feed qualification.

return_load_audit.reason: The current return spring fails the frictionless entry-cam necessary condition; latch, bearing and fork reset add load.
return_load_audit.scope: Analytical necessary conditions; no measured spring, friction, fatigue or dynamic qualification.

trip_leaf_audit.reason: The prescribed chords change centreline length. Buckling load alone does not establish the two stable states, trip threshold, available work or reset path.

coupled_partial_release.reason: An engaged B imposes equal upper/drum angular displacement. After A entry clearance is recovered, either the drum rolls back or the upper cannot return. Changing spring strength alone cannot satisfy return with zero drum motion.

blockers: Return spring is weaker than the frictionless entry-cam load, before reset/latch/bearing loads.
Trip displacement and snap branch are prescribed; a contact-driven elastic equilibrium and energy release have not been established.
No physical interlock holds continuous forward RNA during return/reset. The GUI pause cannot enforce that in hardware.
Before the end trip, B is not held open during partial manual return; after A entry is recovered, B can backdrive the drum or hold the upper away from home.
InputKind changes prescribe a new state. They do not establish accessible mid-stroke reverse transitions.
mechanical_audit.boundary: Actual contact gaps and necessary analytical conditions can reject this candidate. These checks do not solve nonlinear elasticity, frictional contact, rate-dependent reset or physical feeding, and cannot establish a functional PASS.

continuous_travel.proof: Rigid point speed <=1+R/r per mm path, from unit arc-length speed and angular rate <=1/r. Distance to fixed material is 1-Lipschitz; endpoint gaps certify every full interval. Remaining intervals subdivide; unresolved intervals fail.
continuous_travel.body_clearance_reference: The validator separately checks continuous rail/clasp and base tubes against the actual lower body; their section/curvature certificates contain these profiles.
continuous_travel.boundary: Actual saved component solids on the nominal open/closed RNA layouts. Conservative box gaps are refined by exact distance queries near fixed material. Body clearance uses separate continuous tube certificates. Protein and drum envelopes cover the checked native bead/drum positions. The upper envelope bounds prescribed poses, not mechanical causality. RNA/gear contact uses separate actual phase checks. No elastic, force, physical feed or automatic trip/reset qualification.

validation_boundary: Actual saved contacts, torque-blocking witnesses, extended BOP checks of five structural solids, nominal poses, latch bearing geometry, RNA/protein handoff, continuous route bounds, protected cavity wall, stops, seats and sampled assembly. Flexible leaf, trip snap, TPU layout and spring-driven motion remain prescribed states. The independent necessary-condition audit rejects the current mechanism. No claim of a functional automatic release/reset, reliable continuous-pull feeding, printed operation or physical qualification.
engineering_still_required: Return spring cannot overcome the frictionless rest-entry cam load; select and verify a complete replacement force path
Trip spring buckling/energy, trigger preload, latch release force, changing centreline length and repeatable snap direction
Continuous RNA pull: a mechanical gate or measured reset-speed limit; animation pause is not physical gating
Partial strokes, mid-stroke direction changes and externally restrained upper subunit
Spring selection and preload, friction, backlash, TPU tooth stability, clasp retention and fatigue
physical_tests_still_required: Printed fit, assembly, feed/retraction, upper return, force, click sound, wear, durability and hand comfort
